crossrefs.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
By faith we understand that the universe was formed at Godʼs command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens—He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
“Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
This is what God the LORD says— He who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and its offspring, who gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it:
For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.

notes.title: Let there be light, and the new creation
How to read the days of creation

crossrefs.text: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
The true Light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.

notes.title: Let there be light, and the new creation
How to read the days of creation

crossrefs.text: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.
He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.
can you, like Him, spread out the skies, as strong as a mirror of bronze?
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
when He established the clouds above, when the fountains of the deep gushed forth,
when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.

notes.title: How to read the days of creation

crossrefs.text: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by Godʼs word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
“I am a Hebrew,” replied Jonah. “I worship the LORD, the God of the heavens, who made the sea and the dry land.”
Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.
You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.

notes.title: How to read the days of creation

crossrefs.text: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars—all the host of heaven—do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
Thus says the LORD, who gives the sun for light by day, who sets in order the moon and stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—the LORD of Hosts is His name:
Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.

notes.title: How to read the days of creation

crossrefs.text: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.

And out of the ground the LordGod formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
Bring out all the living creatures that are with you—birds, livestock, and everything that crawls upon the ground—so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon it.”
How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”

notes.title: How to read the days of creation

crossrefs.text: By My great power and outstretched arm, I made the earth and the men and beasts on the face of it, and I give it to whom I please.
Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea inform you.
The life of every living thing is in His hand, as well as the breath of all mankind.
I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
for every beast of the forest is Mine— the cattle on a thousand hills.
Two of every kind of bird and animal and crawling creature will come to you to be kept alive.
Every living creature, every creeping thing, and every bird—everything that moves upon the earth—came out of the ark, kind by kind.
Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you. He feeds on grass like an ox.

notes.title: How to read the days of creation

crossrefs.text: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’
and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
For we are Godʼs workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in His own likeness.
